messages:
cara: Heads-up — we're scheduling a base-image compaction + re-sign next Tue 09:00 PT. Need to coordinate RBAC for the signing key, audit retention, and a quick canary plan.
jun: +1. Do we already have a KMS key that supports cosign keywrap? ops wants the exact principal list.
oliver: We have an existing key in projects/prod-kms (purpose: cosign). It currently allows serviceAccount:ci-signer@redwood. Need to add runtime signing principal for image rebase pipeline.
remy: For least privilege, can we create a short-lived principal that only has iam.cryptoSign access and is restricted by resource name? Prefer not to expand the CI signer.
cara: Agreed. Proposal: create kms-signer-temp-sa per-rebuild with 48h TTL, rotate audit entrypoint. Also update image-build pipeline to use KMS KeyVersion-based signing instead of local keys.
jun: Sounds good. Who owns the RBAC request? I can file the IAM PR but need exact members.
oliver: I'll PR the terraform: add google_service_account.kms_rebuild_signer + iam binding "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier" scoped to the key.
remy: Don't forget the audit log requirement: retention 365d for admin activity and 90d for data plane events. We need to ensure key use logs are forwarded to sec-audit and immutable storage.
ops-oncall: For runtime compatibility, ensure the new images pass the runtime validation job (syscalls, seccomp, no setuid binaries) before rolling to canary. If canary fails, auto-roll back to previous signed variant.
security-bot: POLICY CHECK: proposed iam binding will require approval from sec-owners. Attach: /policies/kms-signing/approval-checklist.md (auto).
cara: Checklist I'm tracking: 1) create ephemeral SA & IAM binding 2) KMS key policy updated for keyVersion usage 3) CI pipeline switched to KMS cosign flow 4) Audit sink configured to sec-audit GCS 5) runtime validation job green 6) canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h 7) post-roll log review.
jun: Small config snippet for terraform I will use:
```
resource "google_service_account" "kms_rebuild_signer" {
  account_id   = "kms-rebuild-signer-6598"
  display_name = "Ephemeral KMS signer for base rebuild"
}
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "signer" {
  crypto_key_id = var.base_image_key
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:${google_service_account.kms_rebuild_signer.email}"]
}
```
oliver: Ping me when PR is up, I'll review the IAM policy and add the condition binding for resource name. Also we should add a cloudasset export to capture the grant change.
remy: How about the attestation trail? We should emit a signed provenance entry (in-toto link) to GCS and index to the SBOM service.
cara: Yes — pipeline will upload cosign bundle + in-toto statement to gs://rebuild-provenance/6598/ and trigger sbom-indexer.
ops-oncall: Canary plan: 30min stabilization window per step, health checks: p99 latency, error rate <0.5%, startup time. If any check fails alert: @ops-oncall and auto-roll to previous image.
jun: One gotcha — some runtime nodes have older glibc packaging; the compact image might drop compatibility. Please run the compatibility matrix job (image-compat-check) before signing.
remy: For incident response, add a runbook link in the PR: /runbooks/image-rollbacks.md and ensure oncall has access to cosign rollback keys (we'll grant a separate cosign-rollback SA with granular permission and private-key fallback).
cara: Action items: Jun PR for IAM (+cloudasset export), Oliver verify resource conditions + terraform apply window, Remy wire provenance upload, Ops run compat-job and set canary policy, Security approve policy change.
ops-oncall: I'll schedule the rollout window and page rotation for the ephemeral SA.
jun: PR opened: https://git.redwood/sre/infra/pulls/432 — includes terraform, cloudasset export, and approval request.
oliver: Reviewed and left comments on condition expression; small nits.
remy: Security signoff needed: @security. We should also run a short vulnerability triage on the compact image pre-rollout (automated vulnerability scan + manual quick audit).
cara: Plan to block signing until vuln-scan is green. If any CVE >= High appears, we hold and escalate to eng-ml for dependency patch.
security-bot: REMINDER: create an approval ticket in JIRA with tag KMS-SIGN-6598 and include audit-sink link.
cara: Thanks all — will coordinate final approvals tomorrow 08:30 PT. :thumbsup:
